name: Starter: Nepali
about: Nepali word order, respect levels and everyday verb forms in real sentences.

words.म: I, me (मलाई: to me; मैले: I as a past doer)
words.हुनु: to be (छ, छु, हो, हुँ, छन्, हुन्; छैन and होइन)
words.मेरो: my (मेरी with a feminine noun; मेरा with a plural noun)
words.तपाईंको: your (respectful; तपाईंकी with a feminine noun; तपाईंका with a plural noun)
words.ऊ: he, she (उसले: he or she as a past doer)
words.पर्नु: to fall; to cost; to have to (पानी पर्नु: to rain)

namaste.about: The everyday greeting, respectful enough for almost anyone.

sanchai-hunuhunchha.about: Literally are well; a respectful everyday way to ask how someone is.

maaf-garnuhos.about: Literally please forgive; used to get attention or apologize politely.

kati-bhayo.about: Literally how much did it become; used to ask for the total or price.

pheri-bhetaula.about: Literally we'll meet again; a common way to say goodbye.

items.text: एउटा चिया र एउटा पानी दिनुहोस्।

एउटा चिया र एउटा पानी दिनुहुन्छु।

नमस्ते! तपाईंलाई भेटेर खुसी लाग्यो छु।

concept.line: In a plain Nepali sentence, the object, place and time usually come before the verb: म चिया पिउँछु (I tea drink).

In careful standard Nepali, some possessives and adjectives match the noun, and some third-person past verbs match the subject: मेरो कोठा, मेरी बहिनी, मेरा दाजु; सानो केटा, सानी केटी, साना केटाहरू; ऊ गयो, ऊ गई; everyday speech often uses the basic -ो form instead.

words.means: हुँ = am; हुनुहुन्छ = are; होइनँ = am not

concept.line: Nepali marks respect in pronouns and verbs: for ‘you’, तपाईं is respectful, तिमी familiar and तँ very intimate and sometimes rude; for ‘he/she’, ऊ is familiar, उनी more polite and उहाँ respectful; the verb changes too: तपाईं खानुहुन्छ, तिमी खान्छौ, तँ खान्छस्, उहाँ जानुहुन्छ.

words.means: मसँग = I have; तपाईंसँग = you have

concept.line: मेरो and तपाईंको mean ‘my’ and respectful ‘your’.

words.means: बुझ्दिनँ = do not understand; बुझ्नुहुन्छ = understand

concept.line: The simple present describes habits, facts and regular actions: म खान्छु, तिमी खान्छौ, ऊ खान्छ, हामी खान्छौँ.

words.means: घर = house; घरमा = in the house; at home
जान्छु = go; जाँदै = going; जानुहुन्छ = goes

concept.line: छ says that something exists, is somewhere or is in a state.

words.means: गर्छु = do; गर्नुपर्छ = have to do
जानुपर्छ = have to go; जान = go
